types.label: Collision with injuries

types.label: Hit and run collision
narratives: RP reports a vehicle struck a parked {vehicle} at {near} and left the scene {dir}.

narratives: RP reports a pedestrian was struck by a vehicle at {near}.

narratives: RP reports a motorcycle down with the rider injured at {near}.
Caller advises a motorcyclist went down in the roadway near {cross}.

types.label: Parking lot collision
narratives: RP reports a minor collision in the parking lot at {address}.
Caller advises two vehicles collided in the lot near {near}, no injuries reported.

types.label: Collision blocking lanes
narratives: RP reports a collision blocking {lanes} at {near}.
